# Innovative Gloves

> Innovative Gloves Co., Ltd. is a family-owned disposable glove manufacturer in Hat Yai, Thailand, founded in 2001. We invented the raised diamond grip glove in 2011, the original that the industry went on to imitate, and have since engineered and patented three further grip technologies (Tyre Tread / Gripper, Micro Diamond and Zig). We develop and manufacture nitrile and latex gloves in-house, offering 50+ glove families and 60+ variations, including standard, heavy-duty, long-cuff, biodegradable and private-label products, with in-house compounding, testing, R&D and OEM capability. Certifications include ISO 9001, EN ISO 13485, CE/PPE, US FDA, EU MDR, Australia TGA, Health Canada and SMETA 4-Pillar.

## Grip Technologies
- [Raised Diamond](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/raised-diamond/): invented by Innovative in 2011, the original raised-diamond disposable glove that the industry has imitated ever since. We remain the pioneers and the benchmark for quality.
- [Micro Diamond](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/micro-diamond/): patented high-density diamond grip texture; best grip through oils.
- [Zig Grip](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/zig-grip/): patented directional texture; best dry grip.
- [Tyre Tread / Gripper](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/tyre-tread/): our first patented grip; aggressive heavy-duty grip.
- [Biodegradable Nitrile](https://www.innovativegloves.net/technologies/biodegradable/): engineered to break down faster in active landfill (ASTM D5511 / ISO 15985).
